description: Defines the QuicStreamSequencer class and its interface for buffering and processing QUIC stream frames, including methods for handling stream frames, reading data, and managing internal state.

classes.name: QuicStreamSequencer
classes.description: Handles buffering, ordering, and processing of incoming stream frames for a QUIC stream.

classes.name: QuicStreamSequencer::StreamInterface
classes.description: Interface for communication between the sequencer and the stream, including callbacks for data availability, errors, and stream state changes.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Processes an incoming stream frame, buffering or processing it as needed.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Processes an incoming crypto frame, buffering or processing it as needed.

methods.name: GetReadableRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the next readable regions of data without copying.

methods.name: GetReadableRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the next readable region of data.

methods.name: PeekRegion
methods.description: Provides a view of data starting at a specific offset.

methods.name: Readv
methods.description: Reads data into provided buffers.

methods.name: MarkConsumed
methods.description: Marks a specified number of bytes as consumed.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Appends all readable data to a string buffer.

methods.name: HasBytesToRead
methods.description: Checks if there are bytes available for reading.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream has been closed.

methods.name: SetUnblocked
methods.description: Unblocks the sequencer to process buffered data.

methods.name: SetBlockedUntilFlush
methods.description: Blocks processing until explicitly unblocked.

methods.name: StopReading
methods.description: Discards incoming data and stops calling stream callbacks.

methods.name: ReleaseBuffer
methods.description: Frees memory of the underlying buffer.

methods.name: ReleaseBufferIfEmpty
methods.description: Frees buffer memory if no data remains.

methods.name: NumBytesBuffered
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently buffered.

methods.name: NumBytesConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes consumed.

methods.name: IsAllDataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if all data up to the FIN is available.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string describing internal state for debugging.
